description: This file defines structures and static methods for parsing assistant chat text, including handling custom tags such as <think> and <final> to identify segments of thinking and response in a conversation.

classes.name: AssistantTextSegment
classes.description: A struct representing a segment of assistant text, characterized by its kind (thinking or response) and unique id.

methods.name: segments(from:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Parses raw string input into an array of AssistantTextSegments, optionally including or excluding 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: visibleSegments(from:)
methods.description: Returns only the response segments of the parsed text, excluding 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Checks if the raw input contains any visible (non-ignored) content based on inclusion of 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:)
methods.description: Checks if the raw input contains any response content, ignoring 'thinking' segments.
